title: Intent-Handover: Grounding Language in Human-Usage Regions for Trustworthy Robot-to-Human Handovers
summary: A language-conditioned handover framework that identifies human-usage regions and avoids blocking them with the robot hand or gripper.

mechanisms.name: Intent and human-usage-region handover
mechanisms.description: Maps the receiver's intended use to a human-usage region and plans handover so the region remains accessible and collision-free.
mechanisms.limitations: A language-to-usage-region result and user study do not establish phone-only localization, blind-user intent inference, navigation arrival, or safety.
